# SparseDistributedMemory

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-23

## Definition
A memory model storing patterns in high-dimensional space with sparse activation, enabling robust pattern completion and noise tolerance. Provides a biologically-inspired foundation for scalable, fault-tolerant memory in neuromorphic systems.
